The brief

An auto repair shop in Fort Erie with a clear service menu, published pricing and local search coverage across the Niagara area. The goal was a website that loads fast, explains every service clearly and turns local searches into calls and bookings.

What I did

  • Website development and ongoing updates on WordPress, with responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop.
  • Keyword research and on-page SEO for the main service pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
  • Technical SEO: indexing checks, site speed and structured data (schema markup).
  • Local SEO: location-focused content and local citations for Fort Erie, Ontario, Canada.
  • AEO & GEO: FAQ content and FAQPage schema, written as clear answers that search engines and AI tools can quote.

Highlights

  • A dedicated page for each of its 6 core services
  • Pricing, service areas and FAQ pages that answer buyer questions
  • FAQPage schema live on the site
